## Processing

| Input | Output | Time per piece | Queue capacity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <a class="entity-link" href="/equipment/items/hide/"><img src="/images/icons/hide.png" alt="" width="40" height="40" loading="lazy" />Raw Hide</a> × 1 | <a class="entity-link" href="/equipment/items/leather/"><img src="/images/icons/leather.png" alt="" width="40" height="40" loading="lazy" />Leather</a> × 1 | 45 seconds | 3 |

Processing continues while away or sleeping. Times are before any omen speed bonus; items must be collected when ready. Wet hides do not cure: while it rains (or snows) on a rack with no roof over it, the work waits until the rain stops.
